summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing the consolidated summarized remote voting map for its Annual General Stockholders’ Meeting held exclusively online on April 28, 2026. The filing discloses voting instructions received from the underwriter, central depositary, and directly by the company for each item on the meeting agenda. This is a routine corporate governance filing required under Brazilian CVM Resolution 81/22 and is analogous to a proxy results report. No special situation (e.g., merger, tender offer, restructuring) is present, making this a non-event regulatory disclosure.
